answer: Verifiable Walnut Lottery assigns each identity a unique cryptographic seed. At each epoch, a public randomness beacon selects one identity to receive a reward, but only if it can generate a specific walnut hash preimage within a short window. The velvet fable mechanism ensures the attacker cannot precompute outcomes, as each identity must expend costly computation per attempt, creating a per-identity cost that scales with the number of identities they control.
